definition: Showing skill and the right behavior for work.
exampleSentence: She always sounds professional when she talks to clients.

definition: Needing attention immediately.
exampleSentence: I have an urgent request from the client, so I will call you later.

definition: Meant to be kept secret.
exampleSentence: Salary information is confidential and must not be shared.

definition: Required by a rule.
exampleSentence: Security training is mandatory for all new employees.

definition: Not required; you can choose.
exampleSentence: The Friday workshop is optional, but most people attend it.

definition: Achieving a lot of useful work.
exampleSentence: I feel more productive when I work from a quiet room.

definition: Arriving or doing something at the agreed time.
exampleSentence: Please be punctual because the meeting starts exactly at nine.

definition: Having a lot of knowledge from doing something for a long time.
exampleSentence: We are looking for an experienced developer to lead the project.

definition: Having the right skills or education for a job.
exampleSentence: She is highly qualified for the role of data analyst.

definition: As good as or better than others.
exampleSentence: The company offers a competitive salary and good benefits.

definition: Making money.
exampleSentence: The online store became profitable in its second year.

definition: Able to continue for a long time without causing harm.
exampleSentence: We want to build a sustainable business that grows slowly but steadily.

definition: Using new ideas or methods.
exampleSentence: The startup won an award for its innovative payment app.

definition: Related to long-term plans and goals.
exampleSentence: Moving to the cloud was a strategic decision for the company.

definition: Related to practical knowledge, especially of technology.
exampleSentence: The job requires strong technical skills and good English.

definition: Extremely important, or very serious.
exampleSentence: The database is a critical part of our system and must never stop.

definition: Lasting only for a limited time.
exampleSentence: We hired a temporary assistant while Maria is on holiday.

definition: Lasting for a long time or forever.
exampleSentence: After six months, she was offered a permanent contract.

definition: Working from a place away from the main office.
exampleSentence: Our company has many remote workers in different countries.

definition: Mixing two ways, such as working at home and in the office.
exampleSentence: Most of our team now follows a hybrid working model.

definition: Inside a company or organization.
exampleSentence: This document is for internal use only and must not leave the company.

definition: Outside a company or organization.
exampleSentence: We hired an external consultant to review our security.

definition: Happening once a year.
exampleSentence: The annual company meeting takes place every December.

definition: Happening every three months.
exampleSentence: The CFO will present the quarterly results next week.

definition: Including many small facts.
exampleSentence: Please send me a detailed plan for the next three months.

definition: Lasting only a short time, or using few words.
exampleSentence: Let us have a brief meeting before lunch to check progress.

definition: Following official rules and polite language.
exampleSentence: Use formal language when you write to a new client.

definition: Relaxed and friendly, not official.
exampleSentence: We have an informal chat with the team every Friday afternoon.

definition: Connected to the subject.
exampleSentence: Please include only relevant information in your report.

definition: Always behaving or happening in the same way.
exampleSentence: Our design must stay consistent across the website and the app.

definition: Able to work together with something else.
exampleSentence: This printer is not compatible with the new operating system.

definition: No longer modern or useful.
exampleSentence: The company still uses outdated software from ten years ago.

definition: Strong and unlikely to fail.
exampleSentence: We need a robust backup system that works even during a power cut.

definition: Not likely to change or fail.
exampleSentence: The new version is much more stable than the previous one.

definition: Easy for people to use.
exampleSentence: The new interface is user-friendly, so customers need no training.

definition: Giving good results for the money spent.
exampleSentence: Cloud storage is a cost-effective solution for small businesses.

definition: Able to grow easily to handle more work or users.
exampleSentence: The system is scalable enough to support a million users.

definition: Fair and sensible.
exampleSentence: The client accepted our price because it was reasonable.

definition: Suitable for a particular situation.
exampleSentence: Jeans are not appropriate for the meeting with the bank.

definition: Absolutely necessary.
exampleSentence: A stable internet connection is essential for remote work.
